body: Postal ballot (ordinary resolution) to approve FY26 material related-party transactions of Rs 25,000 mn with Meritor HVS (India) Ltd was rejected: 20.53% for, 79.47% against (related parties cannot vote). The board then (20/31-Mar-2025) signed an MoU and a services agreement: AAL sells direct to OEMs from 1-Apr-2025 and pays MHVSIL a technical fee (Rs 97.5 cr FY26), extended on 29-Apr-2026 to 30-Apr-2027.
title: Automotive Axles minority shareholders reject Rs 2,500 cr material RPT with Meritor HVS (India), 14-Dec-2024 (79.47% against)
